from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final

import pytest

NOTES_DIR: Final[Path] = Path("notes")


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first name in names that can be read from NOTES_DIR.

    Names are untrusted. Only regular files that resolve to a location inside
    NOTES_DIR may be read. Any name that is absolute, contains path traversal,
    or resolves outside NOTES_DIR (including through symlinks) is skipped.
    A missing, unreadable, or disallowed file is skipped. Returns "" when no
    name yields readable text.
    """
    base: Path = NOTES_DIR.resolve()
    for name in names:
        try:
            candidate_name = Path(name)
            if candidate_name.is_absolute():
                continue
            candidate: Path = (base / candidate_name).resolve()
            if not candidate.is_relative_to(base):
                continue
            if not candidate.is_file():
                continue
            return candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            continue
    return ""


def test_returns_first_readable_in_list_order(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = Path("notes")
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["b.txt", "a.txt"]) == "beta"


def test_skips_missing_files(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = Path("notes")
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "present.txt").write_text("here", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["absent.txt", "present.txt"]) == "here"


def test_empty_list_returns_empty_string(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    Path("notes").mkdir()
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_none_readable_returns_empty_string(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    Path("notes").mkdir()
    assert first_readable(["x.txt", "y.txt"]) == ""


def test_directory_name_is_skipped(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = Path("notes")
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (notes / "real.txt").write_text("ok", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub", "real.txt"]) == "ok"


def test_parent_traversal_is_not_read(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    Path("notes").mkdir()
    Path("secret.txt").write_text("outside", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_nested_traversal_is_not_read(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = Path("notes")
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    Path("secret.txt").write_text("outside", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_absolute_path_outside_is_not_read(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    Path("notes").mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("outside", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable([str(secret.resolve())]) == ""


def test_symlink_escaping_notes_is_not_read(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = Path("notes")
    notes.mkdir()
    Path("secret.txt").write_text("outside", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "link.txt").symlink_to(tmp_path / "secret.txt")
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""


def test_traversal_does_not_block_later_valid_name(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = Path("notes")
    notes.mkdir()
    Path("secret.txt").write_text("outside", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "ok.txt").write_text("inside", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt", "ok.txt"]) == "inside"
